author: Fatty420
quote:
If they are going to focus so much on the relationship then they should have made your characters customizable face/bodyshape/race/height etc.
But having their relationship as a base of the story isn’t a good idea. If it was more of a side mission I’d give it a higher score. Also the lack of character freedom and the devs clearly try to forcibly teach you empathy is obnoxious and for that reason I will not be playing the game any further until online comes out. That’s the only thing that can save this game. If they make online woke it’s over for rockstar.
